bio: I'm a software engineer based in Lahore, Pakistan. My core strength is backend development — APIs, data models and integrations — and for the last two years I've paired that with AI: agents that call real tools, answer real customers, and run in production.

At Devisgon I grew from intern to Associate Software Engineer, was named project lead on the LaForme booking platform, and led delivery of the Total Store back-office system — 14 modules, handed over with a 13-page client guide I wrote. Alongside that, I've freelanced since May 2024 for clients who needed systems built end to end.

My final-year project, the UAF Smart E-Library, added a RAG retrieval layer with pgvector. My flagship personal build, MeMySelfI AI, is an agent platform I designed, deployed with Docker on AWS EC2 behind a CI/CD pipeline I set up myself, and managed in live production. Game development is the passion that brought me to this field — it's the track I'm growing into next.
